phase.name: Shravan
phase.successGoal: 61.0 kg or below on or before 2026-11-09

grainMealAllowedNotes: Normal Hindu vegetarian foods are allowed in the one grain meal.
Paneer, soy, tofu, rajma, chana, dal/lentils, Gusta products, normal vegetables and makhana are allowed here.
Onion and garlic are allowed in this meal.
Normal salt is allowed in this meal.

specialtyFoods.singharaFlour: allowed but premium/optional; do not require
specialtyFoods.rajgiraAmaranthFlour: allowed but premium/optional; do not require

whey30g.note: Developer placeholder only. Actual Shravan-compatible product label/Cronometer overrides.

planningDefaults.disclaimer: All recipe macros are planning estimates. Cronometer and the current package/recipe entry remain the source of truth.

developerRules.phaseToggle: When Shravan mode is active, filter meal choices by tags rather than deleting normal recipes.
developerRules.breakfastFilter: Show SHB* recipes. Hide normal breakfast recipes unless explicitly tagged shravan/off-grain.
developerRules.lunchFilter: Show existing L1-L10 with a SHRAVAN - GRAIN MEAL ONLY badge.
developerRules.snackFilter: Show SHS* recipes. Hide normal snacks that contain bread, Gusta, tofu, paneer or normal vegetables.
developerRules.grainCounter: Allow only one grain-meal selection per calendar day in Shravan mode. Require explicit manual override + reason for a second.
developerRules.saltRule: Off-grain recipes display sendha namak only. Grain meal may use normal salt.
developerRules.onionGarlicRule: Off-grain recipes must show onion/garlic prohibited. Grain meal may use them.
developerRules.wheyValidation: Product must be manually marked Shravan-compatible before SHB/SHS/SHT recipes using whey are selectable.
developerRules.premiumRule: SHB9P and SHB10P hidden under Optional/Premium by default.
developerRules.calorieLogic: Do not automatically reduce calories below 1500. If planned total is low, suggest one Shravan add-on or an appropriate top-up.
developerRules.proteinLogic: If actual Cronometer protein is below 110 g, suggest the smallest top-up that fits remaining calories.
developerRules.sourceOfTruth: Actual Cronometer totals override all recipe planning estimates.

newRecipes.name: Banana Cardamom Protein Lassi
method: Blend milk, curd, banana, whey, cardamom and ice until completely smooth.
Taste first; add stevia/monk fruit only if needed.
Drink after the morning walk. No grain, onion, garlic or normal salt is used.
newRecipes.taste: Cardamom + a tiny pinch of cinnamon makes this taste like a thick banana lassi without needing sugar.
newRecipes.prepPacking: No prep required. Pre-portion the whey the night before on hectic days.
newRecipes.tracking: Log the actual whey product, actual milk type, curd recipe and banana in Cronometer.

newRecipes.name: Berry Protein Curd Bowl
method: Whisk curd until smooth.
Mix in whey in 2-3 additions so it does not clump.
Fold in berries and top with weighed peanuts.
newRecipes.taste: Use cardamom for an Indian dessert profile or cinnamon for a cheesecake-style flavour.
newRecipes.prepPacking: Fastest solid breakfast. Frozen berries can be thawed overnight in the refrigerator.
newRecipes.tracking: Weigh peanuts; they are calorie-dense. Use the actual homemade-curd entry.

newRecipes.name: Sweet-Potato Chaat + Protein
ingredients: Shravan-compatible whey isolate: 30 g, mixed with water
method: Cube hot cooked sweet potato.
Season with cumin, pepper, green chilli, coriander, lemon and sendha namak.
Serve curd on top or on the side.
Take the whey separately with water.
newRecipes.taste: Dry-toast cumin before crushing it; finish with plenty of lemon and coriander for a bright chaat flavour.
newRecipes.prepPacking: Microwave or pressure-cook several sweet potatoes at once; refrigerate portions for 2-3 days.
newRecipes.tracking: Log cooked sweet-potato weight, curd and whey separately.

newRecipes.name: Aloo-Dahi Jeera Chaat + Protein
ingredients: Shravan-compatible whey isolate: 30 g, mixed with water
method: Cube warm potato and season immediately so the spices adhere.
Whisk curd with cumin, pepper and sendha namak.
Spoon curd over potato and finish with coriander, chilli and lemon.
Drink whey in water separately.
newRecipes.taste: Use roasted cumin powder plus lemon; this makes the dish taste much fuller without extra oil.
newRecipes.prepPacking: Boil potatoes in a batch and refrigerate. Reheat one portion in the morning.
newRecipes.tracking: Do not log raw potato if you are weighing the cooked portion; use one method consistently.

newRecipes.name: Light Sabudana-Potato Bowl + Protein
ingredients: Shravan-compatible whey isolate: 30 g, mixed with water
method: Soak sabudana using your usual method until the pearls separate easily.
Heat exactly 3 g oil/ghee, bloom cumin and chilli, then add potato and sabudana.
Cook only until the pearls turn translucent; overcooking makes it sticky.
Finish with crushed peanuts, coriander and lemon. Serve curd and whey separately.
newRecipes.taste: Roast the peanuts before crushing them; the nutty flavour makes a small portion feel much more satisfying.
newRecipes.prepPacking: This is a rotation food, not the daily default. Pre-soak the night before.
newRecipes.tracking: Log dry sabudana, weighed peanuts and measured fat. Sabudana is easy to under-estimate.

newRecipes.name: Berry Protein Lassi Bowl
method: Blend all ingredients until thick and smooth.
Use less water for a spoonable bowl and more for a drinkable lassi.
Taste before adding sweetener.
newRecipes.taste: Cardamom + berries gives a shrikhand/lassi direction without needing sugar or honey.
newRecipes.prepPacking: Very low effort after the walk.
newRecipes.tracking: Use actual milk and curd fat percentages because they materially change calories.

newRecipes.name: Apple-Cinnamon Protein Milk + Almonds
method: Shake whey with cold milk and cinnamon.
Eat the apple whole.
Eat the measured almonds slowly rather than adding an unmeasured handful.
newRecipes.taste: Cinnamon in the shake plus a crisp apple gives an apple-pie profile without syrup.
newRecipes.prepPacking: Excellent for mornings when cooking is not realistic.
newRecipes.tracking: Weigh the nuts. A casual handful can double the intended calories.

newRecipes.name: Banana-Peanut Protein Lassi
method: Blend milk, curd, whey, banana and spices.
Crush the peanuts and sprinkle them on top instead of blending them; the crunch improves satiety.
Use stevia/monk fruit only if needed.
newRecipes.taste: Roasted peanuts + banana + cardamom gives a rich dessert-like flavour without needing added sugar.
newRecipes.prepPacking: No cooking; useful on high-stress days.
newRecipes.tracking: Keep the peanut portion at 10 g unless Cronometer shows room for more.

newRecipes.name: Singhara Chilla + Curd + Protein
ingredients: Shravan-compatible whey isolate: 30 g, mixed with water
Jeera, black pepper, green chilli, coriander, sendha namak
Berries or other permitted fruit: 100 g
method: Mix flour, spices, water and coriander into a pourable batter.
Cook 2 small chillas in a non-stick pan using exactly 3 g oil/ghee total.
Serve with curd and fruit; take whey separately.
newRecipes.taste: Cumin, chilli, coriander and lemon make singhara flour far more savoury.
newRecipes.prepPacking: Optional only because singhara flour is relatively expensive in Canada.
newRecipes.tracking: Use only when you actually buy it; do not treat this as a required staple.

newRecipes.name: Rajgira Protein Pancakes
ingredients: Shravan-compatible whey isolate: 30 g, mixed with water
method: Mix rajgira flour, water, cinnamon/cardamom and a little sweetener if desired.
Cook small pancakes with exactly 3 g oil/ghee.
Serve with curd and chopped apple. Take whey separately.
newRecipes.taste: Cardamom + cinnamon + apple makes this taste much better than a plain fasting-flour pancake.
newRecipes.prepPacking: Premium/optional only because rajgira flour can be expensive in Canada.
newRecipes.tracking: The package entry should override the planning estimate.

newRecipes.name: Apple + Whey + Peanuts
ingredients: Shravan-compatible whey isolate: 30 g in a dry shaker
method: Carry whey dry and add water when ready to drink.
Eat the whole apple and measured peanuts.
newRecipes.taste: A pinch of cinnamon in the shaker works well with vanilla whey.
newRecipes.prepPacking: Best no-refrigeration work snack.
newRecipes.tracking: Pre-weigh peanuts at home.

newRecipes.name: Banana + Whey + Peanuts
ingredients: Shravan-compatible whey isolate: 30 g in a dry shaker
method: Mix whey with water at snack time.
Eat banana and measured peanuts separately.
newRecipes.taste: Vanilla/cardamom whey pairs particularly well with banana.
newRecipes.prepPacking: No cold storage required.
newRecipes.tracking: Use edible banana weight when logging if weighing.

newRecipes.name: Orange + Whey + Almonds
method: Carry the whey dry.
Drink with water and eat the orange plus measured almonds.
newRecipes.taste: Citrus after a vanilla shake keeps this snack fresh and light.
newRecipes.prepPacking: No refrigerator required.
newRecipes.tracking: Use a 15 g nut portion, not a handful.

newRecipes.name: Sweet-Potato Curd Box + Whey
ingredients: Cumin, black pepper, coriander, lemon, sendha namak
method: Cube cooked sweet potato and season.
Pack curd separately or spoon over the potato.
Carry whey dry and mix with water when eating.
newRecipes.taste: Use roasted cumin, black pepper and lemon for a proper chaat profile.
newRecipes.prepPacking: Requires an insulated bag/ice pack because of the curd and cooked food.
newRecipes.tracking: Log sweet potato, curd and whey separately.

newRecipes.name: Apple Protein Curd Bowl
method: Whisk whey into curd.
Fold in chopped apple and spices.
Keep chilled until eaten.
newRecipes.taste: Cinnamon + cardamom creates a kheer-like flavour without grains.
newRecipes.prepPacking: Cold pack required for the full work shift.
newRecipes.tracking: Use actual curd values.

newRecipes.name: Banana Milk Protein Shake
method: Blend or shake immediately before leaving if using a well-chilled insulated bottle.
Keep cold until 17:00.
newRecipes.taste: Cardamom makes vanilla whey taste closer to a traditional milkshake.
newRecipes.prepPacking: Use an insulated bag with frozen ice packs. If cold storage is unreliable, replace milk with water and take a whole fruit.
newRecipes.tracking: Actual milk type controls the final calories.

newRecipes.name: Aloo-Dahi Snack Box + Small Protein Shake
ingredients: Cumin, black pepper, green chilli, coriander, lemon, sendha namak
method: Season potato with roasted cumin, pepper, chilli, lemon and sendha namak.
Pack curd separately.
Mix whey with water at snack time.
newRecipes.taste: Use more lemon and coriander rather than extra oil.
newRecipes.prepPacking: Cold pack required.
newRecipes.tracking: This is deliberately a smaller whey serving; use the actual product entry.

newRecipes.name: Mini Sabudana-Potato Snack + Protein
ingredients: Cumin, chilli, coriander, lemon, sendha namak
method: Cook the small sabudana-potato portion in a non-stick pan using the usual soaked-sabudana method.
Finish with peanuts, coriander, lemon and sendha namak.
Serve with curd and take whey separately.
newRecipes.taste: Roasted peanuts, cumin and lemon give the small portion more impact.
newRecipes.prepPacking: Rotation option. Pre-soak the sabudana. Cold pack required for curd/cooked food.
newRecipes.tracking: Log dry sabudana and weighed peanuts; keep portions exact.

newRecipes.name: Water Protein Shake
method: Shake whey with water until smooth.
Use only if required by the day's final Cronometer totals.
newRecipes.taste: Cardamom, cinnamon or coffee can change the flavour without meaningful calories.
newRecipes.prepPacking: Use when protein is low but calories are close to target.
newRecipes.tracking: Use the actual whey label.

newRecipes.name: Milk Protein Shake
method: Shake whey with cold milk.
Use only when both calories and protein remain low enough for this larger top-up.
newRecipes.taste: Cardamom, cinnamon or coffee can change the flavour without meaningful calories.
newRecipes.prepPacking: Use when both calories and protein are still low.
newRecipes.tracking: Use the actual milk and whey labels.

newRecipes.name: Banana Protein Curd
method: Whisk whey into curd, top with banana and spice.
newRecipes.taste: Cardamom makes this feel like a dessert rather than another shake.
newRecipes.prepPacking: Use when the day is substantially short on calories as well as protein.
newRecipes.tracking: Choose this instead of stacking multiple small extras.
